records.rule: Every mutation is a PLAN until --apply.
--add-only adds missing sources and removes none; kept sources print as NOTE kept (add-only).
Every plan names each removal as REMOVE CIDR; Azure and GCP read the rule before updating it.
R8 runs always use --add-only and run outside the sandbox.
No --apply on a firewall without Tom Dyer's direct approval; Codex asks Tom.
Port 22 rules are never touched under R8.
az fails inside Codex's sandbox (read-only HOME, ~/.azure/az.sess).
No --no-cli-pager; AWS_PAGER empty on every aws command.
The live registry (machines, accounts) stays on the workstation; packages carry example IDs.
Architecture Tom Dyer; ooRexx Cloud Control and the 26 Nov fixes Claude (Opus 5.5); dev4 bash adapters ChatGPT/Codex.
